newsitem.title: CHINA: China's gold reserves 12.67 mln ounces end-96.
newsitem.headline: China's gold reserves 12.67 mln ounces end-96.

text.p: China's gold reserves stood at 12.67 million ounces at the end of 1996, unchanged from the end of November, the official Financial News said on Tuesday.
The gold reserves were also unchanged from the end-September figures, the most recent data released previously by Chinese authorities.

The Financial News, published by the central bank, also repeated data showing that the nation's foreign exchange reserves stood at $105 billion at the end of last year. That was an increase of $31.5 billion from the beginning of 1996, the biggest annual rise on record for China.
